Name: JP's Farms - Farm Central - Big Farm for Low-end
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][b][i][size=6][color=#00ff00][u][center]Farm Central[/center][/u][/color][/size][/i][/b]

[color=#00ffff][size=5][i][b]Because a computer should not limit the number of Casks you can have on a map...[/b][/i][/size][/color]


[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Farm Central is a farm divided into 9 farms, all connected to each other.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]All are based on the Standard Farm with slight modifications to increase usable space.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Some farms have special grass for the animals.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b][i][color=#ff7700]Original size of the Standard Farm (80x65) >>> Each of these farms (80x65) + Cliffs removed for more space in general.[/color][/i][/b][/size][/font]
[/list]
[color=#ff0000][size=5][i]There really isn't much more to add, they are normal interconnected farms after all. Hope you enjoy it![/i][/size][/color]

Unzip and move the folder directly to the Mods folder. If you like the mod, click the “Endorse” button at the top of the page ;)
